recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a woman leaning against the corner of a metallic, industrial elevator. She wears a long red velvet coat over a lace top and light blue trousers. The lighting is slightly diffused with a cool, greenish-teal tint reflecting off the metal walls.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant red coat contrasting against the desaturated teal-green industrial background
Subject's upward gaze creating a diagonal tension with the horizontal elevator bar
Tight vertical framing emphasizing the claustrophobic yet stylish environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically, occupying the full height of the frame, leaning into the left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red coat serves as the primary focal point against the muted background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red coat, move up to the subject's face looking upward, then follow the horizontal bar to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right half of the image is largely open, occupied by the flat metal door and the typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue (trousers) and black (lace top and shoes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the coat against low-saturation, mid-value industrial surroundings.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The first word uses a slightly heavier weight than the subsequent phrase
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same typeface family.
graphicDevices: Horizontal metal bar as a compositional divider

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 90s aesthetic and circular counters.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and clean terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body shot of a woman in a long red velvet coat and light blue pants, leaning against the corner of a teal-green industrial elevator. Low angle, soft lighting, film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place geometric sans-serif text in the top right corner. Use a bold weight for the first word in dark purple, and a medium weight for the rest of the phrase in dark green. Keep tracking tight.

verificationChecks: Is the coat a rich red velvet?
Is the background a desaturated industrial green?
Is the text right-aligned in the top corner?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact lace pattern on the top
Any specific brand logos on the elevator hardware

mustAchieve: Strong color contrast between red and teal
avoid: Overly bright or modern digital lighting

postGenerationChecks: Check for film grain and slight blur characteristic of 90s photography
Ensure the red coat is the most saturated element
Verify the text is uppercase and geometric
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Teal Background + Vibrant Red Subject + Geometric Top-Right Typography = 90s Pop Aesthetic
